title: Track Session- Malvern
description: Meet at gate entrance off Thirlstane Road to College grounds. Please be prompt so we can make most of the hour. We will do a good warm up with stretching and drills (all explained and suitable for those runners new to track or advanced runners). Then a track session of various intervals ( no more than 4-5km total running) and can be adapted to suit all abilities. We will cool down and be finished by 7.30pm. 400m grass track. Queries: Andy K [Phone Number Redacted]
